title: An audit that reads the plan, not the status
heading: Check the Plan Against the Rule, Not Against the Solver's Status
cases: a row over its limit with a switch of 7e-7 is reported, and the same row with its switch on is not
a switch of 0.4 counts as off
a total over the limit by less than the tolerance is not reported
every broken row is reported, in the order the rows are given
